answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, and tie that deposit to a single verified work history. A newcomer enters through one narrow inlet: it must complete small, paid, publicly attested jobs before its reputation grows. Like a quill signing each job, its identity is bound to a ledger of completed work, not to a free account name. Forging a thousand identities then means funding a thousand deposits and a thousand job histories - a meadow of fake agents costs real capital and real time, while honest agents keep their stake and earn it back.
